maria: Quick update — all-hands in 20. We're moving recording to Room B (Edison) due to a mic issue in Room A. Agenda change: skip Hiring update, will email slides after. Please join HDMI check 10 min before. @video-ops can you confirm stream fallback? :loud_sound:
video-ops: On it. Recorder couldn't start in Room A, switching to cloud-recorder + backup local OBS. Will post link in ~5. :eyes:
adarsh: Heads-up — Room B only has one HDMI input. Can presenters use wireless dongles or bring adapters?
sophie: I'll bring a USB-C->HDMI and the clicker.
devon: For remote folks — the meeting link stays the same but recording may start a few mins late. @maria can we shorten the live Q&A to 12m?
maria: Yes, Q&A -> 12 minutes. We'll push the product roadmap deep-dive to the next all-hands.
alex: If cloud-recorder fails, fallback command for on-call: ```ssh eng-stream 'start_obs --scene allhands'``` Also set audio device to "Line In (RoomB)".
video-bot: cloud-recorder job failed: err=443-init-timeout — automatic restart triggered.
maria: Thanks. Whoever is speaking first, please keep mic ~6 inches from mouth; last time gain was low. :pray:
adarsh: I'll pre-warm the demo model on a dedicated node and leave it running. Ping me if you want an immediate rerun before go-live.
sophie: Slides uploaded: https://drive.redwood/team/all-hands/2026-03. Updated speaker notes in last slide.
devon: Recording/stream link (will be live once recorder is up): https://live.redwood.com/all-hands/1781578901 — I will paste final status here when live.
video-ops: Posted fallback checklist in #video-ops DM: 1) swap HDMI cables 2) start local OBS on eng-stream 3) verify audio levels + record test 4) confirm viewer URL 5) start cloud-recorder. DMing presenters now.
maria: Awesome. Please do the mic test in Room B at T minus 10. See you all in 20. :rocket:
